title: Do You Think a Banana Is a Berry?
summary: Botanists define a berry by how the fruit grows, not by size or looks. By that definition a banana is a berry, and a strawberry is not.

beats.text: A banana is a berry, but a strawberry is not. Myth or fact? Pause and guess!
In the shop, berries are small, round and sweet. Bananas are long and yellow.

beats.reveal: Fact! Botanists call a banana a berry, and a strawberry is not one.

visual.question: A banana is a berry. Myth or fact?

beats.text: Scientists don't sort fruit by looks. They look at how it grows from the flower.
A true berry has a soft skin, soft flesh and seeds inside. That fits bananas, grapes and tomatoes.
Bonus fact: the tiny dark dots in a banana are its seeds.

visual.text: The tiny dark dots in the middle of a banana are the remains of its seeds.
